Call this FIRST: it shows that Oracle holds both Oklahoma insurance/roofing-regulation facts and 8,000+ Norman and Oklahoma City building/reroofing permit re

tools.name: search_records
tools.description: Search certified Oklahoma records. Find reroofing and building permits (Norman 2015-present; Oklahoma City weekly residential reroofing), contractor activity, permits by address or street, a permit by number, plus Oklahoma insurance and roofing rules (contractor licensing, building code, carrier rat

tools.name: get_record
tools.description: Get one certified record by record_id, from either collection (ids are globally unique), e.g. "OK-PERMIT-2026-04835" (a permit) or "OK-ROOF-2026-0003" (an insurance/roofing fact). Includes sources and certification. To look a permit up by its permit number instead, use search_records with permit_num

tools.name: get_record_history
tools.description: Get the full revision lineage for a record -- every certified record it supersedes or was superseded by, oldest first. Use after get_record or search_records to see how a rule or permit record changed over time.

tools.name: list_changes_since
tools.description: Poll for what changed since a date instead of re-pulling everything: newly certified records, superseded (old->new) pairs, and reconfirmed records. Example: {"since":"2026-10-01","collection":"ok_property_permits"} returns permits certified after that date (new weekly Oklahoma City reroofing permits
